summary: Advanced Micro Devices filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $4.75 billion offering of senior notes across four tranches (2029, 2031, 2033, 2036) with coupons from 4.600% to 5.500%. The offering is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. Notes are unsecured, not guaranteed by subsidiaries, and will not be listed. Underwriters include Barclays, BofA Securities, and others. This filing is an ordinary shelf takedown with no event-driven catalyst.
